headline: Greetings from Paris, where an art installation transformed the Pont Neuf into a rocky cave
context: The oldest bridge in Paris was draped in fabric last month to appear like a mountain cave, in an installation by the artist JR. Unlike a real cave, though, it didn't provide respite from a brutal heat wave.
